title: EvalCase
description: One case, bound to the failure mode it exists to catch. Requiring failure_mode forces every case to name what it is for; a suite of cases that catch nothing in particular measures only that the system still runs.

failure_mode.description: From the fifteen-mode system-level taxonomy. Enumerated here because the TypeScript binding already was, and the schema is the source of truth -- an unenumerated string let two invented modes validate cleanly, which is a rule stated more broadly in the type than in the contract it is supposed to bind.

cluster_id.description: The independent unit this case belongs to. Written by the perturbation expander, never by a suite author -- author-assigned clustering makes every downstream confidence figure depend on how someone chose to group cases. Absent means the case is its own cluster.

perturbation.description: Set when this case is a seeded perturbation of another. Methods assessed only on clean, well-formed inputs degrade sharply under minor perturbation, so perturbed variants belong in the suite rather than in a separate exercise.
